sections.title: AI Services for New York FinTech Organizations
sections.description: Production-grade AI built specifically for New York's financial technology sector with native regulatory compliance.

items.title: Fraud Detection and Transaction Monitoring
items.description: Real-time ML models identifying fraudulent patterns across payment networks, card-not-present transactions, peer-to-peer payments, and account takeover attempts. Gradient boosting (XGBoost, LightGBM) and deep learning models trained on your transaction history — not generic benchmark datasets — achieving meaningful reduction in fraud losses while controlling false positive rates. Typical cost: $50,000–$120,000 | Timeline: 12–22 weeks.
items.label: Fraud detection

items.title: Credit Risk and Underwriting AI
items.description: ML models predicting default probability, delinquency risk, and creditworthiness from both traditional credit bureau features and alternative data signals — with FCRA adverse action reason code integration, ECOA fair lending disparate impact testing, and the documentation that OCC examination requires. Typical cost: $55,000–$130,000 | Timeline: 14–22 weeks.
items.label: Credit risk

items.title: AML Transaction Monitoring
items.description: ML-based AML systems augmenting or replacing rules-based monitoring — identifying suspicious transaction patterns that rule-based systems miss while reducing the false alert burden that overwhelms compliance analysts. Built with BSA/AML regulatory context and FINCEN SAR filing workflow integration. Typical cost: $60,000–$140,000 | Timeline: 14–24 weeks.
items.label: AML monitoring

items.title: Financial Document Intelligence
items.description: NLP and LLM systems extracting structured data from financial filings, credit memos, offering documents, and regulatory submissions at the volume and speed that manual review can't match. RAG-powered systems enabling natural language querying of financial document repositories. Typical cost: $45,000–$100,000 | Timeline: 12–20 weeks.
items.label: Document AI

items.title: LLM Integration for Financial Services
items.description: Integrating GPT-4o via Azure OpenAI (with enterprise compliance), Claude 3.5 Sonnet via AWS Bedrock, and self-hosted Llama 3 for data-privacy-sensitive applications. All financial services LLM integrations include audit logging, data handling documentation, and output validation appropriate for financial information contexts. Typical cost: $25,000–$80,000 | Timeline: 8–18 weeks.
items.label: LLM integration

items.title: Algorithmic and Quantitative Analytics
items.description: ML signal generation for trading strategies, portfolio risk analytics, factor model development, and market microstructure analysis. ClickMasters is not a registered investment advisor — we provide the technology infrastructure; strategy decisions remain with licensed professionals. Typical cost: $50,000–$150,000 | Timeline: 12–24 weeks.
items.label: Quant analytics

sections.title: New York FinTech Regulatory Compliance Built In
sections.description: New York financial services AI must satisfy some of the most stringent regulatory requirements in the US. ClickMasters builds compliance into every engagement.

items.title: Federal Reserve / OCC (SR 26-2)
items.description: Model validation documentation, champion/challenger testing, backtesting, ongoing performance monitoring, and model risk committee review support — standard for any ML model used in credit, risk, or trading decisions at OCC-regulated institutions.
items.label: SR 26-2

items.title: FCRA / ECOA
items.description: Adverse action reason codes derived from SHAP values, disparate impact testing across protected classes, prohibited variable screening, and consistent treatment documentation for consumer credit AI.
items.label: FCRA · ECOA

items.title: BSA / AML (FinCEN)
items.description: Suspicious Activity Report workflow integration, transaction monitoring tuning documentation, and model performance evidence for compliance program effectiveness demonstration.
items.label: BSA · AML

items.title: FINRA
items.description: Communications compliance monitoring, suitability analysis support, and registered representative supervision AI built with FINRA Rule 2111/2210 awareness.
items.label: FINRA

items.title: New York DFS
items.description: Cyber preparedness standards, third-party risk management documentation, and consumer protection requirements specific to New York DFS-regulated entities.

items.question: Does ClickMasters have experience with New York DFS-regulated entities?
items.answer: Yes — ClickMasters builds AI for New York DFS-regulated banks, insurers, and money transmitters with appropriate third-party risk management documentation.

items.question: Can ClickMasters provide SR 26-2 model risk documentation that will satisfy an OCC examination?
items.answer: ClickMasters provides technically accurate model validation documentation aligned with SR 26-2 requirements. Regulatory examination strategy and legal determination of compliance remain with qualified financial services counsel.

items.question: How do we handle FCRA adverse action requirements for our AI credit model?
items.answer: ClickMasters integrates SHAP-based adverse action reason code generation, producing individual-prediction explanations that map to the adverse action categories required by FCRA for consumer credit decisions.

items.answer: New York SHIELD Act, GLBA, and NYDFS cybersecurity regulations apply to most NY financial entities — ClickMasters designs data handling with these requirements in mind and recommends legal counsel for definitive compliance determinations.

items.question: Can ClickMasters work with our existing Bloomberg, Refinitiv, or proprietary data infrastructure?
items.answer: Yes — financial data source integration is scoped during Discovery and designed for your specific data infrastructure.

items.answer: 12–24 weeks for most single-model financial AI applications; enterprise platforms 24–40 weeks.
